description: Chooses which icon shows at the start
why_this_name: The svg- prefix separates the swap from the boolean icon-start that shows or hides the same layer

description: Shows or hides the start icon without changing the layout
why_this_name: Named exactly like its layer because it only toggles that layer

description: Adds a text label and changes the layout to fit it
why_this_name: The has- prefix marks an element whose presence changes the layout
The -copy suffix marks editable text; the layer name is the prop name without -copy

values: rest; hover; pressed; loading; inactive; disabled
description: What the user is doing with the component right now
why_this_name: rest, not default, because rest is not always the default state

description: Shows or hides the focus indicator
why_this_name: A separate boolean because focus can happen at the same time as hover or pressed; true in Figma so designers see it while building
